end.summary: Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to plate.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised identifying food origins and linking longer journeys with fuel use, refrigeration, packaging, energy use, plastic waste, cost and freshness. They used the 10 km example and suggested local, seasonal food, while noting that local choices can have less variety across seasons. Rohan mixed up imported food with being better or more special; at home, compare one local seasonal food with one food brought from farther away and discuss distance, freshness and packaging.
